description: List the schemas in a database of the configured Snowflake account. Requires database. Returns immediately with a job_id and status 'queued' (D0.3 deferred-completion shape) -- the dispatch returning is NOT the same as the job finishing; the schema list itself is delivered when the job completes.
embedding_description: List the schemas inside one Snowflake database, the FIRST drill-down step after list_databases, for orienting inside an unfamiliar database before writing a query. Dispatches asynchronously; the schema names land as their own message once the job completes, not in this call's return.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Dispatch envelope: job_id (string) and status ('queued'). This is NOT the schema list -- that arrives separately when the job completes and is delivered as its own message: schemas, a list of schema name strings.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: This call only confirms the job was queued -- do not present job_id/status as the answer to 'what schemas exist'. Acknowledge the request is in flight; the schema list itself lands in a follow-up message when the job completes. Once delivered, list the schema names plainly (low sensitivity, data_sensitivity 0.1) and suggest list_tables with a schema to go deeper.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: List schemas in a Snowflake database.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: snowflake.invalid_params: missing database. snowflake.api_error: the database does not exist or another warehouse error occurred. snowflake.permission_denied: the role cannot see this database.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: snowflake.invalid_params: supply a database name from list_databases. snowflake.api_error: verify the database name is spelled correctly.
